---
title: "Summary of variables"
date: "`r paste(params$date)`"
params:
  date: !r Sys.Date()
  data: NULL
  envir: globalenv()
output: word_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, cache = TRUE)
```

```{r example, results='asis'}
library(patchwork)

l <- potteR::plot_summary(params$data)
x <- potteR::get_summary(params$data)

out <- vector('list', length = length(l))

for(i in seq_along(l)) {
out[[i]] <-
l[[i]] / gridExtra::tableGrob(x[[i]] |> dplyr::slice_head(n = 10), rows = NULL)
}

out
```
